$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-29-batch-y/2026-10-29-batch-y.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

decisions.question: Plan-facts figures with an unknown source: what counts as a read against the case's documents (CHAT-164 revised)
decisions.recommendation: Revised rule (A0388 area 230.1 keyed confirmed; plan facts source unknown; parcel 211.74; City-implied area within 0.75 %): A keyed figure with status confirmed counts as read against the case's documents; its source is recorded per figure and auto-filled only where exactly one document prints the value; any mismatch goes to the operator. No page number is required; the document is recorded per figure. Alternative, not chosen: re-read each figure from its PDF in the round, keyed values not used (one document read per figure). Cost: a per-figure source check (script) and a read-record; no page capture. Rule text changed (disclosed): the CHAT-164 wording "re-read against their documents, values only, and reclassified in their own pre-registered round; until then they are not read" is replaced by this line.

decisions.question: A keyed value that contradicts an unknown-source figure
decisions.recommendation: Golden value wins (A0399 corner plan facts true, golden none; A0578 area 356.65 vs golden 345.22): Where a keyed value contradicts an unknown-source figure, the keyed value is read and the other figure stays disclosed. Alternative, not chosen: stay unread until a document read. Cost: none beyond the read-record; 2 lots known. Rule text changed (disclosed): the CHAT-164 words "are not read" until the round no longer hold for a figure that a keyed value contradicts.
